title: The general linear groupoid of a Leavitt path algebra
summary: The general linear groupoid $\mathbf{G}(L(E))$ of a Leavitt path algebra $L(E)$ is isomorphic to the groupoid whose objects are all $L(E)$-modules of the form $\bigoplus_{i=1}^n v_iL(E)$ where each $v_i$ is a vertex, and whose morphisms are all isomorphisms between these modules. We find a generating set for $\mathbf{G}(L(E))$ and consequently obtain generating sets for all general linear groups $\text{GL}_n(L(E))$ over $L(E)$ (including the group $\text{GL}_1(L(E))$ of invertible elements of $L(E)$).
